parameters.name: OP6 Rate1
parameters.description: Speed toward envelope level1 after note-on;99 is fastest.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP RATES / K1; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Rate2
parameters.description: Speed toward level2 after stage1;99 is fastest.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP RATES / K2; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Rate3
parameters.description: Speed toward held level3;99 is fastest.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP RATES / K3; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Rate4
parameters.description: Release speed toward level4 after note-off;99 is fastest.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP RATES / K4; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Level1
parameters.description: First envelope destination. Carrier changes affect volume; modulator changes affect timbre.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP LEVELS / K1; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Level2
parameters.description: Second envelope destination, reached after level1.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP LEVELS / K2; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Level3
parameters.description: Sustained destination while the note is held.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP LEVELS / K3; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Level4
parameters.description: Release destination; normally0 for a sound that fades to silence.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / OP LEVELS / K4; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Key breakpoint
parameters.description: Keyboard split point for left/right level scaling; raw note code, not Hz.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / KEY SCALE / K1; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Left key depth
parameters.description: Strength of output attenuation/boost below the breakpoint.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / KEY SCALE / K2; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Right key depth
parameters.description: Strength above the breakpoint.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / KEY SCALE / K3; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Left key curve
parameters.description: 0 negative linear;1 negative exponential;2 positive exponential;3 positive linear.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / KEY SCALE / K4; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Right key curve
parameters.description: Same four curve codes, applied above the breakpoint.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / CURVE / K1; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Rate scaling
parameters.description: Speeds the envelope at higher notes; larger values strengthen the effect.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / SENSITIVITY / K4; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Amplitude sensitivity
parameters.description: How strongly this operator responds to global amplitude modulation.
parameters.location: FM EDIT / SENSITIVITY / K1; SELECT chooses operator on first six EDIT pages. Companion Editor / FM operators / OP6.

parameters.name: OP6 Velocity sensitivity
